verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਹਿਲੋਂ ਦੇ ਜੜ ਪੈਰ ਟਿਕਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee a(n)dhar birakh hoi pahilo(n) dhe jaR pair Tikaiee|

en.bdb: Tree grows on earth and first of all it sets its feet into the earth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ਝਟੁਲਾ ਠੰਢੀ ਛਾਉਂ ਸੁ ਥਾਉਂ ਸੁਹਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: aupar jhoolai jhaTulaa Tha(n)ddee chhaau(n) su thaau(n) suhaiee|

en.bdb: People enjoy swinging over it and its cool shade adorns places.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਸਹੈ ਸਿਰ ਤਲਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: pavan paanee paalaa sahai sir talavaiaa nihachal jaiee|

en.bdb: It bears the impact of air, water and cold but still keeping its head inverse, it remains steadfast at its place.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲੁ ਦੇ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆਂ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਲਵਤੁ ਲੈ ਲੋਹੁ ਤਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: fal dhe vaT vagaiaa(n) sir kalavat lai loh taraiee|

en.bdb: When stoned, it gives fruit and even getting cut with the sawing machine it takes iron (in boats) across waters.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa paraupakaaree sahaj subhaiee|

en.bdb: Life of gurmukhs is useful because by their natural temperament they are altruists.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਧ੍ਰੋਹੁ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: mitr na satr na moh dhroh samadharasee gur sabadh samaiee|

en.bdb: They have no friend or foe. Away from infatuation and delusion they are unbiased and immersed in the word of the Guru.
Their grandness they attain through the wisdom of the Guru and the company of the holy persons.
